sloka: तस्मिन्नपि समापन्ना ऋक्षवानरराक्षसाः ।ते ऽपि स्वर्गं प्रविविशुर्देहान्निक्षिप्य चाम्भसि ।। ७.११०.२७ ॥
transliteration: tasminnapi samāpannā ṛkṣavānararākṣasāḥ ।te 'pi svargaṁ praviviśurdehānnikṣipya cāmbhasi ।। 7.110.27 ॥

translations.english: Even the bears, monkeys, and rakshasas who had gathered there, having cast off their bodies in the water, also entered heaven.
